numbering: Episodes numbered continuously 1–94 across all seasons, with The Final Chapters specials counted as episodes 88–94 (Anime Filler Guide numbering).

arcs.name: Fall of Shiganshina
arcs.summary: Humanity lives behind enormous walls to hide from man-eating Titans, until a colossal Titan appears at Eren Jaeger's hometown.
events: The Colossal Titan breaches Wall Maria at Shiganshina.
Eren watches a Titan eat his mother and vows to wipe them all out.
Eren, Mikasa and Armin flee as refugees.

arcs.name: Humanity's Comeback (Training Corps)
arcs.summary: Eren, Mikasa and Armin enlist in the Training Corps and learn to use the omni-directional maneuver gear.
events: Eren struggles with the maneuver gear until he finds his equipment was broken.
The cadets graduate and choose their branches of the military.

arcs.name: Battle of Trost District
arcs.summary: On the new cadets' first day of duty, the Colossal Titan reappears and kicks a hole in Trost District's wall.
events: Eren is swallowed by a Titan and seemingly killed.
A rogue Titan fighting other Titans turns out to be Eren himself.
Eren in Titan form plugs the breach with a boulder.

arcs.name: Eve of the Counterattack
arcs.summary: The military puts Eren on trial to decide whether a human who turns into a Titan is a weapon or a threat.
events: Levi beats Eren in court to win custody for the Survey Corps.
The cadets pick their branches, and many join the Survey Corps.

arcs.name: 57th Exterior Scouting Mission
arcs.summary: The Survey Corps rides outside the walls, where an intelligent Female Titan hunts for Eren.
events: The Female Titan wipes out Levi's special squad.
Levi and Mikasa rescue Eren from her mouth.

arcs.name: Assault on Stohess
arcs.summary: Armin's suspicions about the Female Titan's identity lead the Survey Corps to set a trap inside the walls.
events: Annie Leonhart is exposed as the Female Titan.
Annie seals herself in crystal after losing to Eren.
A Titan is revealed hidden inside the wall itself.

arcs.name: Clash of the Titans
arcs.summary: Titans appear inside Wall Rose with no breach in sight, and the 104th cadets are caught in the open.
events: Ymir reveals she is a Titan to save Christa.
Reiner and Bertholdt confess to being the Armored and Colossal Titans and kidnap Eren.
Eren uses the Coordinate to command Titans and escape.

arcs.name: Uprising
arcs.summary: The Survey Corps is hunted by its own government as it uncovers who really rules within the walls.
events: Historia is revealed to be the true royal heir.
Rod Reiss explains how the Founding Titan is passed down.
Historia kills her father and is crowned queen.

arcs.name: Return to Shiganshina
arcs.summary: The Survey Corps marches to retake Wall Maria and reach the basement of Eren's childhood home.
events: Erwin leads a suicide charge against the Beast Titan.
Armin is burned saving the plan and is turned into the new Colossal Titan.
Grisha's journals reveal the world beyond the sea.

arcs.name: Marley and the War for Paradis
arcs.summary: The story shifts across the sea to Marley, whose warrior candidates train to inherit Titan powers.
events: Eren infiltrates Liberio and attacks during Willy Tybur's declaration of war.
Sasha is killed by Gabi during the Survey Corps' retreat.
Zeke and Eren's plan to meet splits Paradis's military.

arcs.name: War for Paradis (continued)
arcs.summary: Marley strikes back on Paradis while Eren's true goal comes into focus.
events: Eren and Zeke enter the Paths, where Ymir Fritz holds the key.
Eren takes the Founding Titan's power and starts the Rumbling.

arcs.name: The Rumbling (The Final Chapters)
arcs.summary: Former enemies band together to stop the wall Titans before they flatten the world.
events: Hange sacrifices herself so the alliance can escape.
Mikasa kills Eren, ending the Rumbling and the power of the Titans.
Armin is left to make peace with the outside world.

filler.note: No filler: every episode adapts the manga (OVAs are not counted in the episode numbering).
